component.name: Verdigris
component.summary: Your iPhone's messages, calls, and notifications on Linux

description.p: Verdigris brings a paired iPhone to the Linux desktop over standard Bluetooth profiles — no Mac relay, no cloud service, no subscription.
Verdigris is a fork of Blue. This is its legacy Qt frontend:

ul.li: Read SMS and iMessage conversations and send replies
A live feed of every app's notifications, mirrored over ANCS
Take and place phone calls — caller ID, answer, decline, dial
Daemon health and first-run setup guidance

description.p: Qt / QML desktop app is the primary UI (GTK front-end removed). Global menu includes Settings → Launch at Login.
